requirements.value: Applicant must have been endorsed by original licensing state as being licensed in good standing, and must have satisfied all requirements for regular licensure in Kentucky had they originally applied here.
requirements.quote: An applicant seeking regular licensure in the Commonwealth who was originally licensed in another state may obtain licensure in the Commonwealth without further testing and training if the applicant: (a) Has been endorsed in writing by the applicant's original licensing state as being licensed in good standing in that state; and (b) Would have satisfied all the requirements for regular licensure described in the preceding subsections had the applicant sought original licensure in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made or presented false, fraudulent, or forged statement in connection with a license application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made or presented, or caused to be made or presented, any false, fraudulent, or forged statement, writing, certificate, diploma, or other thing, in connection with an application for a license or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced or aided fraud, forgery, deception, collusion, or conspiracy in connection with a licensing examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practiced, or aided or abetted in the practice of fraud, forgery, deception, collusion, or conspiracy in connection with an examination for a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed, procured, or aided in the procurement of an unlawful abortion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed, procured, or aided in the procurement of an unlawful abortion, including a partial-birth abortion or an abortion in violation of KRS 311.731

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entered a guilty or nolo contendere plea, or been convicted of a crime as defined in KRS 335B.010.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered a guilty or nolo contendere plea, or been convicted, by any court within or without the Commonwealth of Kentucky of a crime as defined in KRS 335B.010, if in accordance with KRS Chapter 335B

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a sexual offense involving a patient or found to have had sexual contact with a patient while under the physician's care.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of a misdemeanor offense under KRS Chapter 510 involving a patient, or a felony offense under KRS Chapter 510, 530.064(1)(a), or 531.310, or been found by the board to have had sexual contact as defined in KRS 510.010(7) with a patient while the patient was under the care of the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Become addicted to a controlled substance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Become addicted to a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Become a chronic or persistent alcoholic.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Become a chronic or persistent alcoholic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice medicine according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental or physical illness or other condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been unable or is unable to practice medicine according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental or physical illness or other condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public or any member thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made a false statement in any document executed in connection with the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made, or caused to be made, or aided or abetted in the making of, a false statement in any document executed in connection with the practice of his profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed an unlicensed practitioner or aided and abetted unlawful practice of medicine or osteopathy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed, as a practitioner of medicine or osteopathy in the practice of his profession in this state, any person not duly licensed or otherwise aided, assisted, or abetted the unlawful practice of medicine or osteopathy or any other healing art

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or attempted to violate any provision of any medical practice act, including the board's code of conduct or regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated or attempted to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisted in or abetted the violation of, or conspired to violate any provision or term of any medical practice act, including but not limited to the code of conduct promulgated by the board under KRS 311.601 or any other valid regulation of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any agreed order, letter of agreement, final order, or emergency order issued by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any agreed order, letter of agreement, final order, or emergency order issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in or attempted to engage in practice under a false or assumed name, or impersonated another practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in or attempted to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy under a false or assumed name, or impersonated another practitioner of a like, similar, or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained a fee on the fraudulent representation that a manifestly incurable condition could be cured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtained a fee or other thing of value on the fraudulent representation that a manifestly incurable condition could be cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violated a confidential communication.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully violated a confidential communication

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license to practice medicine revoked, suspended, restricted, or limited in any other state or jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his license to practice medicine or osteopathy in any other state, territory, or foreign nation revoked, suspended, restricted, or limited or has been subjected to other disciplinary action by the licensing authority thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed or refused to practice medicine in a rural area in violation of a valid medical scholarship loan contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed or refused, without legal justification, to practice medicine in a rural area of this state in violation of a valid medical scholarship loan contract with the trustees of the rural Kentucky medical scholarship fund

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gave or received any fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for referring patients.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Given or received, directly or indirectly, from any person, firm, or corporation, any fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for sending, referring, or otherwise inducing a person to communicate with a person licensed under KRS 311.530 to 311.620

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been removed, suspended, expelled, or disciplined by any professional medical association or society when the action was based upon what the association or society found to be unprofessional conduct, professional incompetence, malpractice, or a violation of any provision of KRS Chapter 311

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff for unprofessional conduct, incompetence, malpractice, or violation of KRS Chapter 311.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of the hospital, including removal, suspension, limitation of hospital privileges, failing to renew privileges for cause, resignation of privileges under pressure or investigation, or other disciplinary action if the action was based upon what the hospital or medical staff found to be unprofessional conduct, professional incompetence, malpractice, or a violation of any provisions of KRS Chapter 311

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with requirements of KRS 213.101, 311.782, or 311.783 regarding abortion reporting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with the requirements of KRS 213.101, 311.782, or 311.783 or failed to submit to the Vital Statistics Branch in accordance with a court order a complete report as described in KRS 213.101

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with requirements regarding making or maintaining medical records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with any of the requirements regarding making or maintaining medical records or documents described in KRS 311.7704 or 311.7707

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with requirements of KRS 311.7705 or 311.7706.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with the requirements of KRS 311.7705 or 311.7706

definition_quote.value: the 'practice of medicine or osteopathy' means the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities
definition_quote.quote: the "practice of medicine or osteopathy" means the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe and administer drugs as part of the broad practice of medicine. Prescribing via telehealth requires proper physician-patient relationship establishment including verified identity, documented diagnosis, and maintained records.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribes or dispenses any medication: (a) With the intent or knowledge that a medication will be used or is likely to be used other than medicinally or for an accepted therapeutic purpose

license_status_types.quote: "Regular license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy at any place in this state; "Limited license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy in a specific institution or locale; "Temporary permit" means a permit issued to a person who has applied for a regular license; "Emergency permit" means a permit issued to a physician currently licensed in another state; "Fellowship training license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy in a fellowship training program; "Special faculty license" means a license to practice medicine that is limited to the extent that this practice is incidental to a necessary part of the practitioner's academic appointment

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of medical schools outside the United States or Canada must: speak/read/write English; complete prerequisite coursework; graduate from a board-approved foreign medical school (or be a US citizen with a diploma from a US school obtained via transfer program); pass the board-prescribed examination; be certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or an approved US specialty board; complete a postgraduate training program of duration established by the board.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Has been certified by the educational commission for foreign medical graduates or by an approved United States specialty board

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician prescribing via telehealth (electronic/computer means) must establish a proper physician-patient relationship including: verification of patient identity, establishment of a documented diagnosis through accepted medical practices, and maintenance of a current medical record. An electronic, online, or telephonic evaluation by questionnaire is inadequate for initial or follow-up evaluation.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: In response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship: 1. Verification that the person requesting medication is in fact who the patient claims to be; 2. Establishment of a documented diagnosis through the use of accepted medical practices; and 3. Maintenance of a current medical record.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby enacted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the Compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Supervision" means overseeing the activities of and accepting of responsibility for the medical services rendered by a physician assistant.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A PA may prescribe and administer all nonscheduled legend drugs as delegated by the supervising physician. With board approval (after at least 1 year experience), a PA may prescribe Schedule III, IV, and V controlled substances as delegated by the supervising physician. Schedule III prescriptions limited to 30-day supply without refill; Schedule IV/V limited to 6-month supply total; benzodiazepines and Carisoprodol limited to 30-day supply without refill. PAs may not dispense controlled substances.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant who has been approved by the board pursuant to paragraph (b) of this subsection, may prescribe and administer Schedules III, IV, and V controlled substances, as described in KRS Chapter 218A, to the extent delegated by the supervising physician

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician may enter into supervision agreements with no more than four (4) physician assistants and shall not supervise more than four (4) physician assistants at any one (1) time.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: any hospital or medical staff of said hospital located in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, shall report all actions taken against a licensed physician as described in KRS 311.595(20) and (21) to the board within thirty (30) days of the final adjudication of said action

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may establish by contract, including with a nonprofit corporation, or otherwise the Kentucky Physician Health Foundation to promote the early identification, intervention, treatment, and rehabilitation of individuals licensed by the board who may be impaired by reason of illness, alcohol or drug abuse, or as a result of any physical or mental condition.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: When a hearing or inquiry panel has probable cause to believe a physician is suffering from a physical or mental condition that might impede his ability to practice competently, the panel may order the physician to undergo a physical or mental examination by persons designated by the panel.

sexual_misconduct_training_required.quote: The board, the hearing officer, and investigators hired by the board shall receive training on the dynamics of sexual misconduct of professionals

limit or restrict a license for an indefinite period
place a licensee on probation for a period not to exceed five (5) years
suspend a license for a period not to exceed five (5) years
revoke any license heretofore or hereafter issued by the board

Persons who are nonresidents of Kentucky and licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in their states of residence and are providing medical services as a charitable health-care provider in Kentucky through a nonprofit, all-volunteer sponsoring organization
"Expedited license" means a full and unrestricted medical license granted by a member state to an eligible physician through the process set forth in the Compact.

Graduates of medical or osteopathic schools approved by the board, while engaged in performing supervised internship or first-year postgraduate training approved by the board at hospitals in this state. All first-year postgraduate trainees shall register with the board at no cost
